text:
anya: Quick sync — I pushed a draft of the migration playbook for the API rollout to /docs/migrations/v2-playbook.md. Need owners for the deprecation windows, SDK bumps, and any infra gating items. TL;DR: target soft-deprecation week of Jul 8. Checklist below.

matt: Can you paste the short deprec windows here? want to triage infra + SLA impact.

anya: Sure, short summary: 
```
{ "soft_deprec_start": "2024-07-08", "hard_deprec": "2024-09-01", "grace_period_days": 55 }
```
Owners I need: JS SDK, Py SDK, Gateway routing, Canary ops, Docs, Release comms.

sam: I can own JS SDK bumps and telemetry hooks. Will open PRs by next Tue.

lee: I'll take Gateway routing & canary wiring. Will add circuit-breaker test cases to the staging gateway.

jordan: Oncall question — do we need a fallback model or endpoint during the transition? If traffic spikes off the new route we should fail open to the v1 endpoint.

deploy-bot: Canary created: gw-route-v2 -> canary-20240601. Use `/canary status canary-20240601` to check health.

carol: Docs: I'll add migration notes and a short changelog for customers. ETA 2024-06-10 for first pass.

matt: Need Python SDK owner for the feature-flag + compat tests. @jordan?

jordan: I can own python SDK compat tests. Will sync with @sam on test vectors and tokenization edge cases.

anya: Great. Here's the minimal rollout checklist I added to the playbook (please confirm):
- owners assigned (JS, Py, gateway, canary, docs)
- SDK PRs + compat tests open
- gateway canary running 72h with synthetic traffic
- monitor token-level latency and error rate dashboards
- send customer notice 2 weeks before soft-deprec
- hard-deprec rollback plan on file

sam: One small ask — include a quick backwards-compat smoke test snippet in the SDKs. e.g.:
```js
// ensure v1 client still works with v2 endpoint alias
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-13b', prompt: 'hello' });
assert(res.text.length > 0);
```

lee: I'll add gateway healthchecks to the canary job and link the runbook.

matt: I'll coordinate with release to reserve the July 8 slot and make sure infra autoscale is ready.

anya: Perfect. I'll update the playbook with the owner table and a short timeline, then ping this thread when done. If anyone wants to swap ownership, speak now.

jordan: I'll open the python SDK PR Friday and add the compat test harness.

carol: I'll draft the customer-facing migration note after the docs first pass and share for review.

matt: :thumbsup: thanks all, will follow up with release calendar invite.

anya: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for owner handoffs. I'll post the updated playbook link here once it's live.
